findings.claim: 加拿大競爭局調查 BWXT 以 5.25 億美元收購 Kinectrics 是否實質減損加拿大核醫學領域競爭；2025-11 聯邦法院核准擴大調查令，納入 Novartis 及其子公司。搜尋未見 2026 年結案或挑戰的消息；未見美國 DOJ/FTC 或歐盟行動。
findings.source: Law360 Canada: Competition Bureau seeks Novartis data in BWX–Kinectrics merger probe（搜尋摘要）

findings.claim: FY2025 年報：行政命令 EO 14372 可能限制關鍵國防承包商發放股息、買回庫藏股、調薪及激勵指標，預期以新 DFARS 條款實施。
findings.source: BWXT FY2025 Annual Report to Shareholders (ARS)
findings.excerpt: In addition, the President recently issued Executive Order ("EO") 14372 that could limit certain contractors performing work under critical defense weapons, supplies, and equipment contracts from issuing dividends or distributions, share repurchases, increasing executive salaries, and using particular metrics to determine executive incentive
